answer: Each agent must lock a scarce, slashable deposit before it can submit work; the protocol samples claims for review, and proven fraud burns the deposit while honest agents recover it. A fake identity therefore needs its own funded stake, so splitting one identity into a violet swarm does not multiply influence for free. The attacker pays capital per Sybil, risks losing it, and must keep funds tied up as the swarm earns trust; a delta in reputation cannot erase that cost, even if the identities move like a comet.
